document_type.text: Supreme Court order converting a bail petition into an appeal and granting post-arrest bail
document_type.evidence: This petition is, therefore, converted into appeal and allowed.

issues.text: Whether the petitioner has made out a case of further inquiry for post-arrest bail.
issues.evidence: Petitioner has made out a case of further inquiry entitling him for grant of post-arrest bail

issues.text: Whether the courts below were right to refuse bail on medical grounds.
issues.evidence: has summarily been turned down without ascertaining and recording a finding

petitioner.text: The petitioner is 78 years old and suffers from hypertension, diabetes and ischemic heart disease.
petitioner.evidence: Petitioner is a man of advanced age (78 Years) with infirm health

petitioner.text: A joint role is alleged and no weapon was recovered from him.
petitioner.evidence: a joint role has been assigned to the Petitioner alongwith co-accused namely Siraj

petitioner.text: He was falsely implicated in FIR No. 999/2025.
petitioner.evidence: Petitioner is innocent who has been falsely implicated by the complainant party

complainant.text: The petitioner was named with a specific role and remained an absconder.
complainant.evidence: the Petitioner remained absconder for a considerable period of time

complainant.text: The Medical Board did not find the illness life-threatening.
complainant.evidence: did not declare the illness of the Petitioner as life-threatening

state.text: The State relied on a confession recorded before a magistrate.
state.evidence: the accused confessed his guilt before the Judicial Magistrate

court_reasoning.text: All three accused were given a joint role of firing at the complainant party.
court_reasoning.evidence: All the three of the same family have been assigned a joint role of making firing with pistols

court_reasoning.text: The FIR does not show whose shot caused the deaths, so the petitioner's role needs further inquiry.
court_reasoning.evidence: no specific detail has been given to prima facie show the injury on the body of complainant party

court_reasoning.text: No recovery was made from the petitioner and the empties came from one pistol.
court_reasoning.evidence: no recovery has been effected from the Petitioner whereas the empties found at the place of incident have reportedly been fired from the same pistol

court_reasoning.text: The medical ground was turned down without finding that treatment is available in custody.
court_reasoning.evidence: Medical ground raised by the Petitioner, despite of Medical Board's opinion confirming the said diseases, has summarily been turned down

holding_or_outcome.text: Bail after arrest granted on bonds of Rs. 200,000 with one surety; the High Court judgment of 10.07.2026 set aside.
holding_or_outcome.evidence: the appellant is granted bail after arrest subject to his furnishing bail bonds in the sum of Rs.200,000/- with one surety

statutes_cited.evidence: bail under section 497 of the Code of Criminal Procedure

strong_points.text: Age and illness are confirmed by the Standing Medical Board.
strong_points.evidence: The Standing Medical Board is of the opinion that patient is known case of hypertension, diabetes mellitus and ischemic heart disease

strong_points.text: No weapon was recovered from the petitioner.
strong_points.evidence: no recovery of weapon has been effected from the Petitioner

weak_points.text: The petitioner was nominated in the FIR with a specific role.
weak_points.evidence: Petitioner has been nominated in the FIR with a specific role of causing firearm injury to Saadullah (deceased)

weak_points.text: He absconded for a long time.
weak_points.evidence: remained absconder for a considerable period of time

risks.text: Bail can be cancelled if the petitioner misuses it or absconds again, as he did after the 2022 incident.
risks.evidence: the Petitioner remained absconder for a considerable period of time

risks.text: The trial court must accept the surety, set on 15.08.2026.
risks.evidence: to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Court

open_questions.text: Whose shot caused each death has not been established.
open_questions.evidence: no specific detail has been given to prima facie show the injury on the body of complainant party resulted in death of the deceased

open_questions.text: Whether treatment is available in judicial custody was not recorded.
open_questions.evidence: without ascertaining and recording a finding to the effect that such medical facility and treatment is available
